decision.summary: A correlated N/U offset initiates abruptly around index 495, persists for ~13 samples, and shows only partial recovery by index 508; no opposing return observed within allowed context [455,545]. E exhibits a weak compensating rise but no clear reversal. The event lacks a confirmed return, so status is uncertain.

intervals.observation: N and U show correlated multi-sample drop (N: ~-2 to -4 MAD, U: ~-2 to -3 MAD) starting near index 495, sustained through ~505–508; E shows slight rise. Recovery begins after 508 but does not reach pre-drop level by end of allowed context (545); return is unobserved/ambiguous.
